svg.title: Serv: from contract to business response
svg.desc: Serv restores the business body before contract validation and procedures. Guard failure skips the handler. Ordinary access denials remain inside the encrypted boundary. Handshake/preflight have their own access checks, and excluded paths or static resources follow their configured routes.
svg.metadata: flowchart TB A["HTTP entry: locale, trace and trusted address"] B["Transport: verify message and decrypt business body"] C["Access policy → verified request context"] D["Contract input validation and route guards"] E["Call business procedure / handler"] F["Standard result or error → authenticated encrypted response"] G["Finalize outer audit, trace headers and return"] X["Reject with standard error; skip business handler"] A --> B B --> C C --> D D -->|"passes"| E D -->|"fails"| X E --> F X --> F F --> G classDef default fill:#edf3ff,stroke:#476aab,color:#172b4d,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef good fill:#e9f6ef,stroke:#28734e,color:#17452f,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef stop fill:#fff0f0,stroke:#af4040,color:#742b2b,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef pending fill:#fff6df,stroke:#a07827,color:#654b18,stroke-width:1.5px; class G good; class X stop;

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif

svg.text: Serv: from contract to business response
